name: Kinki2 -Taboo- ~Hospital Taboo~
source:
A new nurse comes to a hospital where protagonist works. He knows her already being introduced three years ago, and her shy personality, delicate body and innocent face excite him. He has a key to a secret room in the hospital where he can do whatever he wants to her.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公工作的医院来了一名新护士。三年前经人介绍时，他便已认识对方。她腼腆的性格、纤细的身体与纯真的面容让他欲火中烧。主人公还掌握着医院某间密室的钥匙，在那里，他可以随心所欲地对待她。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
